DOI record corroborates the same abstract.

sections.title: Short overview
sections.text: Stiny connects shape-grammar computation with topologies constructed through closure operations.

sections.title: The stated claim
sections.text: The abstract says these topologies structure shapes according to their computations, allowing emergence to coexist with continuity.

sections.title: What can be identified
sections.text: Closure operations and computation-dependent structure are the announced mathematical devices. Their exact definitions and the continuity argument require the full paper.

sections.title: What remains unchecked
sections.text: The short abstract provides neither proofs nor worked examples. Continuity here should not be assumed to mean smooth visual motion or a prohibition on new parts.

sections.title: Reading question
sections.text: Ask which topology is assigned, how the computation determines it and which map is proved continuous. Those are questions for the original, not reconstructed results.
